lines.t: (Intro — Female)
Yeah—turn it up, turn it up, ayy,
When the Spirit hits the room, I’m amazed.
Feel the freedom in my chest right now.
I like the joy when His love breaks in,
Move with the light ’cause He freed me again.
Hands to the sky, yeah, we’re praising loud,
When His glory hits once, it can shake the crowd.
Feel that fire, fire—yeah, feel that fire, fire,
Lift His name up higher, can’t hide it, hide it.
Walk in the room and His peace takes over,
Every chain fall off when He pulls me closer.
Grace on my life and the freedom is louder,
Step to the beat and the darkness gets weaker.
Don’t need the world, got His love within,
If He opened this door, I’mma run right in.
Hope in my step, joy all on my face,
When His fire hits my heart, I can’t help but praise.
(Pre-Chorus — Female)
All night, yeah, we live so free,
’Cause the Savior broke the chains on me.
Take it higher, higher—feel alive,
In His presence we ignite.
(Chorus — Female)
I like the joy when His love breaks in,
Move with the light ’cause He freed me again.
Hands to the sky, yeah, we’re praising loud,
When His glory hits once, it can shake the crowd.
Feel that fire, fire—yeah, feel that fire, fire,
Lift His name up higher, can’t hide it, hide it.
Su luz me levanta, mi alma revive.
Cuando Él me llama, la noche se olvida,
Y todo mi pasado se queda sin brilla’.
Fuego del cielo, mi guía, mi fuerza,
Con Él en el ritmo la duda se quiebra.
Sube la fe, que la gloria comienza,
Su paz en mi pecho rompe toda tristeza.
Sigo confiando, Él nunca me falla,
Con Cristo en mi canto la victoria estalla.
Oh-oh, fuego que no para,
Oh-oh, Su amor que dispara.
Oh-oh, fuego que no para,
Oh-oh, Su amor que dispara.
When His light shows up—darkness steps back,
No turning back, we’re walking His path.
I like the joy when His love breaks in,
Move with the light ’cause He freed me again.
Hands to the sky, yeah, we’re praising loud,
When His glory hits once, it can shake the crowd.
Feel that fire, fire—yeah, feel that fire, fire,
Lift His name up higher, can’t hide it, hide it.
